assumptions: Background-only 2026-08-14 mismatch check; its raw response is not registered, and the separate replayable 2026-08-28 R3 site-recognition snapshots do not backfill this metric or prove the provisional boundary wrong.

osm_named_street_average_offset_m.formula: mean(documented nearest offsets for four named OSM street centre-lines)
assumptions: Crowdsourced centre-lines are not survey data or road redlines; the raw response for the 2026-08-14 mismatch check is absent, and the separate replayable 2026-08-28 R3 site-recognition snapshots are not its recomputation basis.
osm_named_street_average_offset_m.baseline: Repository basis note records 533–898 m offsets.
osm_named_street_average_offset_m.action: Retain mismatch as a source-warning signal.
osm_named_street_average_offset_m.recompute_trigger: Register the raw response for this exact 2026-08-14 check and/or official road geometry before recalculation; do not substitute the separate 2026-08-28 R3 site-recognition snapshots.
